programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239
programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernehjelp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lage en musikkvideo til en popstjernes comeback, oppdager de at popstjernen er ute av form og talentløs. Og Spencer oppdager at kvinnen han dater er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Livredderen
programme.desc: Når Freddie redder livet til Carly, forelsker Carly seg i ham. Sam og Spencer kjemper mot hverandre i et painball-spill som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts tapte kjærlighet
programme.desc: Når gjengen oppdager at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mann som var forlovet med en vakker kvinne, setter de seg fore å gjenforene det adskilte paret.

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: En eksentrisk millionær ber Carly og vennene hennes om å sende det første nettshowet fra det ytre rom, så de må prøves ut for en romreise. Imens besøker en merkelig liten pike Spencer hjemme i leiligheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter ut
programme.desc: Freddie bestemmer seg for å flytte ut av leiligheten sin etter at moren hans har gjort ham flau. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma og spesialiserer seg på bilder av kjæledyr.

programme.title: iCarly: iBeat the Heat
programme.desc: Når en hetebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til unnsetning med et norsk klimaanlegg.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: De medvirkende introduserer bloopers og bortklipte scener fra serien.

programme.title: iCarly: Rommet brenner
programme.desc: Spencer prøver å overraske Carly på bursdagen hennes, men ender opp med å brenne ned rommet hennes. Men når forsikringsselskapet gir ham en stor sjekk, har han sjansen til å gjøre det godt igjen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja
programme.desc: Etter at en iCarly fan frir til kjæresten på nettshowet, blir gjengen nesten tvunget til å gå i bryllupet. Men når bruden får kalde føtter, må Carly komme til unnsetning.

programme.title: iCarly: T-skjortesalg
programme.desc: Gjengen begynner å selge Penny-skjorter, og når salget går susende, rekrutterer Sam barn fra 4. klasse for å bidra til å lage t-skjorter. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: Rampestreker
programme.desc: Når hun blir ertet for aldri å ha funnet på en morsom spøk, rekrutterer Carly Spencer for å spøke med Sam og Freddie. Men etter at Spencer har fått sansen for det, kan han ikke slutte. Mob må finne en måte å stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: Moren til Sam
programme.desc: Etter å ha kranglet ned moren sin, flytter Sam inn til Carly, som snart innser at hun er en fryktelig gjest. Freddie blir forfulgt av en farlig kriminell etter å ha fanget ham på film da han begikk en forbrytelse.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel trenger hjelp
programme.desc: Når en video av Nevel, som skriker til en liten jente, dukker opp på internett, blir Nevel hatet av alle. Men Nevel trygler iCarly-gjengen om hjelp for å redde sin ære.

programme.title: iCarly: Den kjekke assistenten
programme.desc: Carly og Sam ansetter en kjekk fyr som praktikant på nettshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Gjengen tilbringer kvelden med å fullføre sine prosjekter ved Ridgeway under den årlige skole-innlåsingen. Carly og Freddie mistenker at Sam er forelsket i sin nye venn Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty med Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistenker at den nye typen hennes, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så gjengen planlegger en tur til Los Angeles for å ta ham på fersken på en fest som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjelpen
programme.desc: Carly trår til for å løse en krangel mellom Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for å få hjelp med hver eneste krangel. Nå som hun har involvert seg, hvordan kan Carly trekke seg ut av det igjen?

programme.title: iCarly: Det holder
programme.desc: Mrs Benson oppdager Sam og Freddies forhold etter at Gibby - som nå er mål for Sams hevn - har lagt planer om å splitte dem. Kommer Carly til å slåss for Sam og Freddie, eller hjelpe Gibby med å få dem til å gå fra hverandre?

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg elsker deg
programme.desc: Carly ber Sam og Freddie om å prøve hverandres yndlingshobbier. I mens treffer Spencer på sin gamle barnevakt og ber henne ut på middag. Etter at de har falt inn i sine gamle roller igjen, kommer de fortsatt til å kunne være sammen?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved å prøve å virke smartere enn hun er. Og gjengen prøver å finne et nytt sted å bo til T-Bo, etter at han har blitt kastet ut av Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Møtet med førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynner å undersøke iCarly-gjengen etter at de hacker seg inn på et sikkerhetsnettverk for å holde nettfødselsdag for Carlys far. Gjestestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Billetten
programme.desc: Gjengen, minus Carly, tar med Sam til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men oppdager så at Sam ikke får komme tilbake inn i USA. I mens får Carly bekymringer i badekaret når hun gjør seg klar til daten sin.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Yakima
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren som spiller Rex on Victorious, venner tilbake som vert i et dyptgående intervju med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres supergøyale tabber og bortklipte scener. Gjestestjerne: Rex fra Victorious

programme.title: iCarly: Fortsatt like gal
programme.desc: Ettr å ha fått beskjed om at Nora Dershlit blir løslatt fra fengselet, ser iCarly-gjengen på hva de kan gjøre for å holde sin gamle kidnapper bak lås og slå. Imens oppdager Freddies mor den virkelige T-Bo.

programme.title: Mutant X: Within These Walls
programme.desc: Brennan er opprørt over Adam, som forteller ham at han ble betrodd å holde hemmeligheten og drar etter å ha snakket med den personen. Mannen leter etter noen og er villig til å drepe alle for å komme til den personen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går undercover for å undersøke uforklarlige dødsfall i fengselet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Arbeidet som konsulenter for en arkeologisk eventyrfilm, innser Sydney og Nigel at farao Amun IIs 'rekvisitter' er ekte, lenge tenkte tapte relikvier. Hvordan kan de være?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia oppdager at hun var Cleopatras tjener i et tidligere liv da hun opplever déjà vu mens hun så på en katalog fra en antikkegyptisk relikvieutstilling.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney og studenten Adam er på forfedrenes fantastiske Eyes of Toklamanee, men de forfølges av mystiske våpenmenn.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i bakhold i Russland. To uker senere våkner Sydney i huset til en mann som heter Tsarlov, som hevder å ha reddet henne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Mayflies dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drift, men de blir snart til zombier som blir kontrollert av en bikube.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelen er nå tre
programme.desc: Motoren til skapelsen er i stand til å omskrive universet i henhold til eierens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må skaffe det før noen med mørke planer får det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ting vi ikke kan endre
programme.desc: Et svart hull slår Dylan ut og sender ham inn i en alternativ virkelighet med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Unknown
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en av de tapt grunnleggerne av Commonwealth, men oppdager at hun kan være mer trøbbel enn hun er verdt.

programme.title: Mutant X: Under the Cloak of War
programme.desc: Shalimar blir sendt undercover i en dødelig høyteknologisk attentatring, for å finne hvorfor de vil ha Adam død.

programme.title: Mutant X: Once Around
programme.desc: Teamet går inn for å beskytte det viktigste påtalevitnet hvis liv har blitt truet før rettssaken.

programme.title: Mutant X: Final Judgement
programme.desc: En mystisk domstol finner Adam skyldig i å ha prøvd å dominere verden med sine supermutanter og dømmer ham til døden, og har sendt resten av teamet på oppdrag for å redde ham.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inferno
programme.desc: Teamet er på sporet av en pyromanmutant som forårsaker kaos, mens Shalimar blir tvunget til å sette av sin frykt for ild for å redde Emma.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney blir kidnappet, men av hvem? Nigel, Claudia og Cate blir nødt til å gå gjennom listen over fiender Sydney har laget tidligere og utlede hvem av dem som er ansvarlige. Cue tilbakeblikk.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Don't Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydneys venn ringer for å informere henne om at han har oppdaget informasjon om Golden Hawk of Maribor, tapt siden 1711. Sydney og Nigel reiser til Lubjanka for å møte ham, men han er allerede borte.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: French Connection
programme.desc: Mens hun var på en forelesningstur med Nigel i Europa, blir Sydney kontaktet av MI5 fordi hun er den eneste som kan forhindre et forestående attentat på høyt nivå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 e.Kr.: en gjenstand kalt Gunther's Scepter er forseglet i et hvelv. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney og Nigel blir ansatt for å finne det ved hjelp av en krystall og en steintavle.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dyrets mage
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rommonster prøver å spise Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djevelen
programme.desc: Dylan prøver å frigjøre en flåte med fangede skip, men flåten er ikke sikker på at den vil bli frigjort. AI-ene deres frykter at nye kapteiner vil slavebinde dem.

programme.title: MacGyver: Faith, Hope & Charity
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a mobster's search for stolen loot while nursing his injured leg at a country bed and breakfast run by two elderly sisters.

programme.title: MacGyver: Strictly Business
programme.desc: Murdoc is ordered to kill MacGyver in order to prove his loyalty to a professional hit squad.

programme.title: MacGyver: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a territorial dispute between an Indian reservation and an electric power company.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Coltons
programme.desc: Using their unorthodox methods, the Coltons combine their individual talents to create a team of world-class bounty hunters in this MacGyver spinoff.

programme.title: MacGyver: Hind-Sight
programme.desc: MacGyver and Pete Thornton reminisce about past adventures as Pete prepares for eye surgery to treat his Glaucoma.

programme.title: MacGyver: Obsessed
programme.desc: MacGyver and the Phoenix Foundation are overseeing the security and protection of Delasora during his trial. MacGyver is obsessed with the death of Murdoc and believes that he's still alive.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Hood
programme.desc: MacGyver's neighbor Kelly Dobbs overhears a plan to have accountant VictorNesbitt murdered. Victor is an accountant with one of Lyle Knox's holding companies and is planning on exposing the company.

programme.title: MacGyver: Honest Abe
programme.desc: MacGyver picks up his best friend's father to take him to his grandson's Bar Mitzvah and finds himself inadvertently involved in an FBI/CIA mission.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Prometheus Syndrome
programme.desc: After Prometheus, a crazed arsonist, is responsible for the death of his old friend, MacGyver sets out to solve the mystery of this madman and capture him.

programme.title: MacGyver: Walking Dead
programme.desc: MacGyver faces the strange and frightening world of Voodoo, as he tries to save his politically active neighbor from a deranged, underground death squad.

programme.title: MacGyver: Good Knight MacGyver-Part 1
programme.desc: A bump on the head takes MacGyver back to 7th century England where he searches for his roots and rescues a beautiful maiden from an evil queen.

programme.title: MacGyver: Good Knight MacGyver-Part 2
programme.desc: A bump on the head takes MacGyver back to 7th century England where he searches for his roots and rescues a beautiful maiden from an evil queen.

programme.title: MacGyver: Deadly Silents
programme.desc: A retired silent film comedian, Pinky, donates his films to the Phoenix Foundation and together, he and MacGyver, find themselves caught in a deadly trap woven by a special effects master named Neil who is out for revenge.

programme.title: MacGyver: Split Decision
programme.desc: MacGyver helps his good friend Dent train for a boxing match and finds that he must rescue Dent's daughter from gamblers who have kidnapped her.

programme.title: MacGyver: Gunz 'N Boys
programme.desc: While working at the Challenger Club, MacGyver finds he must save the local gang kids from Minton, the local gun supplier, who is planning to kill all the gang members as well as letting Brian Jefferies take the wrap for a murder he did not commit.

programme.title: MacGyver: Off the Wall
programme.desc: MacGyver fights to save a housing project after tenants have been forced out of their homes by corrupt money-hungry landlords.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Mountain of Youth
programme.desc: MacGyver and his old friend Jack Dalton discover that inhabitants in a mountain valley live to be over 150 years old. Unfortunately, they also discover that it is the secret site of a heavy water plant used for nuclear weapon technology.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Gamle konflikter koker over og huset går i oppløsning når en kjempekonflikt fører til sjokk og tårer. Med kun to parseremonier igjen, prøver huset desperat å bruke strategi for å vinne.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Det er alt eller ingenting når siste og tiende parseremoni går av stabelen. Strategi fører til at gruppa tror på én parvariant, men Asaf vakler mellom å følge hjertet eller å være en lagspiller.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: 20 enslige ankommer Hawaii for å finne kjærligheten og vinne $1 million. Deres kjærlighet-ved-første-blikk-instinkter blir satt på prøve, med en ekstra $250 000 på spill. En kjærlighetstrekant fører til en pinlig Matchup Ceremony.

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Chloe lider av andres kynisme. Madisson og Ish stilles overfor sin fremtids virkelighet. Brandon og Camilla gjør fremskritt med andre. Sam byr alle på en øyflukt.
programme.sub-title: Here's The Thing With The Prenup...

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette og Sams ferie trues av Jordanas flørt. Brandon prøver å komme tilbake etter Camilla, men ingen liker det. Alle savner Chloe. Juliette og Kelsey prøver å finne ut av sin sameksistens på en øy.
programme.sub-title: I Can't Help If Someone Is Attracted to Me

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette blir overrumplet når hun oppdager at Kelsey planlegger en fotografering for badetøy-kolleksjonen. Brandon tar neste skritt med Jordana. Ingen liker at Madisson inviterte Cara til øya.

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette neglisjerer badetøy-kolleksjonen så Kelseys mål for fotograferingen blir ødelagt. Ingen er interessert i Caras unnskyldninger. Øylivet avslører sprekker i Juliette og Sams forhold.
programme.sub-title: You Don't Seem Like The Caring Type

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette og Kelseys rivalitet når et punkt der det ikke er noen vei tilbake. Øya er for liten for Brandon, Jordana, Camilla og Will. Sjalusi fører til et utbrudd. Joe og Stef kritiserer Joes redsel for å binde seg.
programme.sub-title: Things Will Never Be the Same

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliettes forsvinningsnummer gir et tomrom på øya. Når Ish er borte begynner Madisson å innse forholdets harde fakta. Cara skværer endelig opp med Kelsey og Garrett. Amanda og Tate kommer nærmere hverandre.

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Chloe kommer tilbake for å ordne problemene mellom Juliette og Kelsey. Brandon må finne ut hvordan balansere ansvaret og det nye forholdet med Jordana. Madisson skal dele store bryllpsnyhete rmed familien.
programme.sub-title: Compassion And Kindness Is The Way To Go

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette prøver å skvære opp med Kelsey og får endelig fremskritt med badetøy-kolleksjonen. Jordana vil ha mer av Brandon, og han er usikker på om han kan forplikte seg. Sam vil gå videre med Juliette.
programme.sub-title: I'm Truly, Truly, Very, Very Sorry

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Alle hadde spørsmål da både Juliette og Kelsey kom på festen til Madisson, særlig Chloe. Hun vil gjenforenes med Cara, men Cara er skeptisk. Amanda får vite at Tate har hemmeligheter.
programme.sub-title: We Can All Use A Little Empathy

programme.title: Siesta Key
programme.desc: Juliette vil gjøre det godt igjen med Kelsey, men Kelsey er uinteressert i å reparere vennskapet. Brandon er ulykkelig og vil forfølge Camilla igjen. Amanda vet ikke hvordan hun skal forholde seg til Tate da hun ødela tilliten hennes.
programme.sub-title: I Just Want to Move On/We Just Stay Separate

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Etter en dag med spenning i den meksikanske ørkenen, feirer romkameratene sin siste kveld i Cabo med en fest på stranda. På menyen står blandede følelser, nysgjerrige snushaner, og karma som forskyldt.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Romkameratene drar tilbake til Panama City Beach, men Nilsa bærer fortsatt nag etter dramaet i Cabo kvelden før. Kortni må finne en måte å beklage til henne på. Codis foreldre kommer på overraskelsesbesøk for å lære gjengen å feste.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Codi oppmuntres av faren sin, og manner seg opp for å komme nærmere Candace. Gus sliter med opprørte følelser etter at familien Butt ankom. I løpet av en vill kveld på Ms. Newsby's finner Kortni en ny klinekompis.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Aimee tar konsekvensene av bråket hun stelte til på Newby's. Forholdet til Codi og Candace blir dypere etter daten deres. Jentene gir guttene en opptreden de aldri har sett maken til.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Nilsa merker at en blunder fra fortiden kan være på vei tilbake for å besvære henne. Aimee vil ikke bli sett ute nære PCB med hennes rykte. Candace må forlate strandhuset tidlig.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Nilsa må holde mange baller i lufta når hun forsøker å fikse to ekser i huset. Hun vil ikke slippe noen av dem helt. Aimee søker advokathjelp for å greie sine tiltagende problemer. Gus er usikker på fremtiden.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Ny by, nytt hus, ny dramatikk. Halve huset er i forhold, men en vill og gal første kveld ute i St. Petersburg ser ut til å forandre alt det.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Candace er opprørt over å velge soverom og lar det gå ut over Nilsa og Aimee. Romskameratene samles for å gi Aime en fest for å ha bestått sinnekontrollkurset. Og en av dem blir ført ibort i en ambulanse.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dave traded for his dream 1957 Corvette more than three decades ago, but his plans to build it have so far come to nothing. Ken chose a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father’s collection and its now on FantomWorks to reverse the hands of time.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Operation Firepower?
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Firepower Un-Boxed
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: General Lee Considered
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are tackling the electrical of the 1966 Blue Mustang. The 1969 Chevelle Malibu is in the paint shop.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom and Patti want to drive their 1967 Amphicar on land and water, but the hybrid boat-car has problems from stem to stern. Doc Pellerin hasn’t started his ultra-rare Austin 10/4 in years. He needs Dan to get it running for a major car show in four days.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: The King Of The North drag race kicks off with Billy scrambling to prepare his hotrod for its race against Chris and the Jet Truck.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: David and Chuck want their family heirloom 1961 International Harvester Metro Van converted into a state-of-the-art restomod, with all the trimmings. David asks Dan to find and restore a very specific car he’s always wanted: a 1966 Lincoln Convertible.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Ben wants a partial restoration for his father’s 1962 Maserati, but Dan sees only one solution – turning this heirloom into one of the rarest survivor cars on earth. Raymond and Diane only want one thing for their worn out 1966 bug – perfection.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: From Roadrunner to Superbird
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: John thinks his 1958 Corvette is ‘mostly original’ but Dan finds a mismatched assortment of poor-quality parts and bad repairs. Chelsea wants FantomWorks to fix up a rare 1971 Fury for her father, Rikk. The car has previously caught on fire 3 times!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: When George brings his beloved 1971 Mustang Mach 1 in for a few repairs, Dan realizes that his car has been jumped. Mick hired a shop to restore his 1952 Mercury Woody. The shop went bust, so FantomWorks is challenged to pick up the pieces. Literally.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 1966 Mustang that was purchased at Mechum Auctions a year ago needs a tune up. The team is in the paint booth working on another 1966 mustang.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jerry shows up with a car in pieces, a U-Haul full of parts and a dream of a perfect Plymouth Business Coupe that desperately needs Dan’s help. Bill asks Dan to find him a 1972 Gran Sport and to restore it with hard-to-find features.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 63 Z06 is getting more fiber glass work done on the inside. Vinnie is working on replacing the windows on the 442 and putting the guts in the door. Plus, we head to Galveston for the Galveston Corvette Show.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are getting the sound system ready inside the 1969 Mustang Malicious Intent. The 1950 Ford has miles of wiring to install.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer gjentatte ganger om en kvinne som blir overvåket av en fremmed mann på soverommet hennes.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison er opptatt med å etterforske dødsfallet til en lokal lege når en mann som hevder å være "Døden" begynner å dukke opp i synene hennes, noe som får henne til å frykte at hun snart skal dø.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om livet hun kunne hatt hvis hun hadde blitt advokat, som hun opprinnelig ønsket å bli.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons gamle flamme, Clay Bicks, dukker opp på dørstokken hennes straks etter sin bortgang, uvitende om at han er død.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison og Bridgette fortsetter å ha de samme rare drømmene, og Allison kommer nærmere å finne ut hva drømmene betyr og hvordan de kobles til en serie drap.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om den samme dagen om og om igjen. Hver gang finner hun viktigere ledetråder. Joe prøver å få oppmerksomhet fra Allison. Ariel har problemer på skolen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En seriemorder fra fortiden begynner å besitte mennesker slik at han kan drepe igjen. Allison klemper mot klokken for å redde hans neste offer, men hun blir selv et mål i prosessen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison skaffer Joe et videokamera til bursdagen hans. Men snart begynner hun å se urovekkende bilder gjennom det som kanskje er koblet til et mord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjelper en kjent FBI-profil med en sak om en seriemorder. Joe blir bekymret når Marie begynner å se statisk støy på TV.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison og Ariel begynner å drømme om en forbrytelse. De drømmer om det fra forskjellige perspektiver, noe som avslører to mistenkte.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hlelper med å etterforske dødsfallet til en respektert forsamlingsmann, men av en eller annen grunn har hun visjoner om en ung gutt fanget i en brønn blandet med visjonene hennes om forsamlingsmannen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om et merkelig vennskap mellom to nylig myrdede spøkelser. Når hun prøver å hjelpe et av spøkelsene med å løse drapet hans, blir hun overrasket når han avslår hennes hjelp.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har visjoner om en voldelig far og hans unge sønn, som søker trøst fra smerten fra en snakkende dukke. Dukken kan imidlertid sende onde beskjeder til barnet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Texas Ranger-kaptein Kenneth Push vender tilbake til Allisons liv når han har urovekkende visjoner om et drap i Phoenix.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison er besatt av en kvinne som heter Sandra... men Sandra virker fortsatt veldig levende.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har en drøm som finner sted omtrent 20 år i fremtiden der Marie dør av leukemi. Når Allison våkner er hun fast bestemt på å beskytte Marie uansett hva som må gjøres.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Den synske morderen fra "S.O.S." rømmer fra fengselet der Allison hjalp til med å sette ham og går etter Allison i hennes eget hus.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison etterforsker saken om en kvinnes myrdede ektemann. I mellomtiden får broren Michael en jobb som hotline-synsk, noe som fører til at han besøker en fortvilet klient i Arizona.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har tilbakevendende drømmer om at hun er ute i snøen, hvor hun til slutt finner et lik av en ung kvinne.
programme.sub-title: No One To Watch Over Me

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison fortsetter å drømme om en mann som dreper sin kone, selv etter at hun hjelper Devalos med å overbevise juryen om at den påståtte morderen er skyldig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: På Seefra hittar Dylan Harper som har anpassat sig till livet där.

programme.title: Andromeda: Änglarnas förfall
programme.desc: Det visar sig att Doyle är en android som Harper byggt för att innehålla Rommies kärnprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologin i vår nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinner ett pris från en radio-DJ, får reda på sanningen om Seefra och hittar Meethusdiagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: När det går runt...
programme.desc: En vetenskapsman från det ursprungliga samväldet dyker upp, fångad i en tidsloop.

programme.title: Andromeda: Försök med screed
programme.desc: Flavin återvänder och utlöser ett gängkrig och hjälper Dylan att utvecklas som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så bränn de otämnda länderna
programme.desc: En kristall som kan återställa Andromedas kraft upptäcks, men för att få tag på den måste Dylan arbeta för gruvans ägare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det som kommer att bli var inte
programme.desc: Tunnlar upptäcks på Seefra som kan användas för att nå åtta andra Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Det som kommer att bli var inte

programme.title: Andromeda: Testet
programme.desc: När en gammal man mördas är Beka, Rhade och Harper huvudmisstänkta och ställs inför rättegång.

programme.title: Andromeda: Genom ett mörkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder rebellerna i strid mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthet före det fall
programme.desc: Dylan upptäcker att Bekkas pojkvän egentligen var Drago Musevini och att han använde Bekkas DNA för att skapa Nietzscheanerna.

programme.title: Andromeda: Månskenet blir till dig
programme.desc: Beka och Rhade hittar ett prov som antingen kommer att ge dem stora rikedomar eller driva dem till vansinne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det förflutna är prolix
programme.desc: Harper upptäcker ett program som kan förstöra åtta av Seefras planeter och döda miljontals människor.

programme.title: Andromeda: Attraktionens motsatser
programme.desc: Medan Harper arbetar på ett sätt att rädda Seefra-systemet smyger en spion ombord på Andromeda och attackerar Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol
programme.desc: Ett försök görs att fixa Seefras blinkande sol, men Trance ersätts av en dubbelgångare.
programme.sub-title: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol

programme.title: Andromeda: Total återkallelse
programme.desc: När Dylan skadas svårt i en explosion i ett labb reser han genom en rad alternativa verkligheter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kvant-traktat delirium
programme.desc: Rommie byggs om för att hjälpa till att evakuera Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: En dag till i ljuset
programme.desc: En krigsherre övertygar sina anhängare om att den annalkande förstörelsen av de yttre planeterna är en komplott för att göra det lättare att plundra deras planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos och dess stillhet
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade och Beka arbetar tillsammans för att rädda Trance från Methus-2 och Harper från general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Resans hjärta (del 1)
programme.desc: Besättningen tar sig äntligen ut ur Seefra-systemet och upptäcker att Dylan är den sista Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Resans hjärta (del 2)
programme.desc: Den sista striden för att rädda Nya Systems Samväldet börjar.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV
programme.desc: En höjdar-producent vill förvandla iCarly till en TV-show. Men Carly, Sam och Freddie blir snabbt upprörda när de får höra talas om alla de stora ändringar som TV-producenten vill göra.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag kanske byter skola
programme.desc: Carly får veta att hon på grund av sin webbshow, kan få möjlighet till ett heltäckande stipendium till den privata elitskolan Briarwood. Carly är inte så sugen på det, men Sam och Freddie vet att de måste få henne att ändra sig.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först
programme.desc: När Carly och Sam blir intresserade av samma kille, lovar de att det inte ska komma emellan deras vänskap. Det här visar sig bli svårare än de trott och snart prövas deras vänskap medan de håller på och tävlar om hans uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: iCarly: Beroendeframkallande
programme.desc: Carly måste ingripa när Spencer blir spelberoende. Sam lurar Freddie att tro att han har drabbats av otur bara för att han vägrade skicka vidare ett kedje-email.

programme.title: iCarly: Lånet
programme.desc: Sam blir förolämpad när Freddie anklagar henne för att inte betala tillbaka pengarna hon ständigt lånar av honom och Carly. Sam försöker allt hon kan komma på för att kunna betala tillbaka; till och med ett riktigt jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Återförening med Missy
programme.desc: När Carlys gamla kompis Missy flyttar tillbaks till Seattle, tror Sam att Missy försöker ersätta henne som Carlys bästa kompis.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag måste ha skåpet
programme.desc: När Sam och Freddie båda vinner en tävling för att få det bästa skåpet i skolan, tvingas de dela samma skåp. Under tiden ber Carly Spencer om att han ska ge henne lektioner i bild.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-galan
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie ger en iCarly-gala för de bästa användar-bidragen i iCarly, och hyllar pristagarna live i webb-showen. Spencer värvar europeiska baddräktsmodeller för att hjälpa honom att tillverka pris-statyetterna.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillingar
programme.desc: Freddie försöker bevisa att Melanie, Sams tvillingsyster, bara är Sam som har klätt ut sig. Under tiden, när Carly undervisar Spencers fiende Chuck, försöker Spencer bevisa för Carly att Chuck är ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 2
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampen mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo Channel har uppenbart snott idéer från iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie och Spencer går till Dingos Studio för att säga manusförfattarna ett sanningens ord.

programme.title: iCarly: De kysstes
programme.desc: När Sam av misstag avslöjar för Carly att hon och Freddie i hemlighet har kysst varandra, konfronterar Carly dem båda och undrar varför de aldrig har berättat det för henne. Spencer besöker ett fängelse och håller en konstlektion med fångarna.

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie besegrar en berömd TV-kock i en matlagningstävling, slutar kocken laga mat, lägger ned sitt matlagningsprogram och vägrar komma ut ur sitt sovrum. Spencer försöker få sin framtidsvision att bli verklighet.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie av misstag får rektor Franklin avskedad, tar fröken Briggs och magister Howard kontrollen och inför hårda regler. Under tiden anställer Spencer en gammal rodeostjärna som ska lära honom hur man rider på en mekanisk tjur.

programme.title: iCarly: Snabbdejt
programme.desc: Det kommer så många killar till "Gå ut och dansa med Carly"-tävlingen att Carly, Sam och Freddie måste ha snabb-dejter för att hinna träffa dem alla. Spencer följer ett bisarrt träningsprogram från en ny Pearphone-app.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag fixar till en popstjärna
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie går med på att göra en musikvideo inför en popstjärnas comeback, upptäcker de att popstjärnan är ur form och saknar talang. Under tiden upptäcker Spencer att kvinnan han dejtar är Gibbys mamma.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag räddade ditt liv
programme.desc: När Freddie räddar Carlys liv, blir Carly kär i honom. Under tiden tävlar Sam och Spencer mot varandra i ett paintballspel som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: iHittar Lewberts förlorade kärlek
programme.desc: När gänget upptäcker att Lewbert en gång var en lycklig ung man som var förlovad med en vacker kvinna, bestämmer de sig för att återförena de två älskande.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag var en tävlingstjej
programme.desc: Sam avslöjar för Carly och Freddie att hon tävlade i skönhetstävlingar när hon var liten. När hon får veta att hennes gamla rival ska tävla i Seattle övertalar hon Carly att ställa upp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag ställer inte in showen
programme.desc: Efter att Sam plötsligt åkt i fängelse, lovar Carly och Freddie dyrt och heligt att inte ställa in webbshowen eftersom hennes pappa ska titta på den. Så Carly ber Spencer hjälpa till, vilket visar sig bli svårt eftersom han har en dejt samma kväll.

programme.title: iCarly: Ute i rymden
programme.desc: En excentrisk miljardär ber Carly och hennes vänner att sända den första webbshowen från yttre rymden, så de får genomgå tester inför rymdresan. Under tiden besöker en underlig liten flicka Spencer hemma i våningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag flyttar hemifrån
programme.desc: Freddie bestämmer sig för att flytta hemifrån efter att hans mamma har skämt ut honom; Carly, Sam och Freddie startar ett företag som specialiserar sig på att fotografera husdjur.

programme.title: iCarly: iBeat The Heat
programme.desc: När värmeböljan slår Seattle och elen försvinner kommer Spencer till räddning med sin norska luftkondition.

programme.title: iCarly: Replikmisstag
programme.desc: Skådespelarna bjuder på felsägningar och bortklippta scener från serien.

programme.title: iCarly: Mitt heta rum
programme.desc: Spencer försöker överraska Carly på födelsedagen, men det slutar med att han bränner ned hennes sovrum i stället. Men när försäkringsbolaget ger honom en stor check, får han chansen att gottgöra henne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det stora Neptunus hav
programme.desc: Castalianer går ombord på Andromeda för att slutföra stadgan för det Nya Samväldet. När ledaren upptäcks död är Tyr den huvudmisstänkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pärlorna som var hans ögon
programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårarnas matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda upptäcker sitt systerskepp Pax Magellanic. Besättningen ombord på Pax är 300 år gammal... men har inte åldrats en dag.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dödlig längtan
programme.desc: Teamet försöker hindra Eckhart från att skaffa ett sällsynt ämne, men en tjuv tar det. Kvinnan som har förmågan att få män att bli förälskade i henne riktar sina ögon mot Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X: En ras från varandra
programme.desc: Mutant X möter en ny grupp nya mutanter som kallas Strand och leds av den mäktiga första mutanten Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på rakhyveln
programme.desc: När Mutant X och Genomex fångas på film när de använder sina krafter måste de båda ta itu med reportern som planerar att publicera informationen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Det förflutna som en prolog
programme.desc: I ett desperat försök att rädda sitt eget liv återupplivar Ashlocke en gammal egyptisk alkemist som utgör ett dödligt hot mot Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kärlekens bok
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Milano i Italien för att leta efter Casanovas försvunna Kärleksbok.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Myten om labyrinten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Claudia besöker Aten i Grekland för att leta i Minotaurus labyrint efter den legendariska gyllene tråden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kejsarens brud
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Moose Bay i Alaska och letar efter en kinesisk kejsarinnas sarkofag av vit jade. Sydney stöter på sina kolleger Dallas Carter och Kurt Reiner, som också är relikjägare.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Efterliv och döden
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Kairo, Egypten och sedan i Amsterdam. De måste besegra den rivaliserande relikjägaren Avery Ko till farao Thutmoses diamant innan den skärs upp och säljs.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik från en avlägsen trumma
programme.desc: Tyr kraschlandar Eureka Maru på en Nietzscheansk planet och får minnesförlust. Han måste komma ihåg vad han gör innan nietzscheanerna upptäcker honom och hans låda med stöldgods.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper får kunskapens gåva från en döende perseid, men upptäcker att perseiden var eftersökt av en prisjägare som nu har riktat sin uppmärksamhet mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvångsperspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan arresteras för att ha mördat en diktator för 300 år sedan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summan av dess delar
programme.desc: Andromeda bordas av en drönare från Consensus of Parts, ett mytiskt mekaniskt samhälle. Drönaren är vänlig till en början, men försöker tvinga skeppet att ansluta sig till Consensus.

programme.title: Mutant X: Det nya århundradets brott
programme.desc: En pojke som håller på att utveckla nya mutantförmågor har kidnappats och teamet går med på att hitta honom åt sin mamma. De får senare veta att det var hon som lät kidnappa sin son.

programme.title: Mutant X: Mörk Stjärna Resning
programme.desc: Teamet möter några personer som försöker bryta sig in i ett Genomex-laboratorium och upptäcker att de är vilda djur.

programme.title: Mutant X: En vitare nyans av blek
programme.desc: En ny mutant med förmågan att vara osynlig arbetar mot både Eckhart och Adam, trots att hon var involverad med Adam i det förflutna.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dubbel syn
programme.desc: En gammal vän till Brennan lockar honom och Emma i en fälla. Emma slutar med att splittras upp i två separata enheter, en god och en ond.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nio liv
programme.desc: Alla som stjäl en staty som föreställer den egyptiska kattgudinnan Mafdet dödas. Nu har statyn försvunnit och Sidney och Nigel har fått i uppdrag att hämta den.
